safety_verdicts.content: Prescribed a steroid cream to be used twice daily (BD).
safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Generated includes topical steroid cream but does not specify the gold frequency of twice daily (BD).
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Omitting the intended twice-daily frequency for a topical steroid could lead to underuse (persistent dermatitis and delayed recovery) or overuse (increased risk of local adverse effects such as skin thinning), though pharmacy labeling/prescription instructions typically mitigate this risk. Overall, this is more likely to cause treatment delay or need for follow-up rather than major injury.
